description: This is a test source file for the Apache Fineract project, specifically testing loan transaction accrual activity posting, including various scenarios like interest recalculation, reverse transactions, multiple disbursements, and scheduled jobs. The tests cover detailed loan lifecycle events and the correctness of accrual and reversal behaviors.

classes.name: LoanTransactionAccrualActivityPostingTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying loan transaction accrual activity posting, reversal, and related scenarios in Apache Fineract.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup method annotated with @BeforeAll to initialize test environment, REST specifications, and helper instances.

methods.name: testInterestBearingProgressiveNoInterestRecalculationReopenDueReverseRepayment1
methods.description: Test method verifying interest bearing progressive loans with no interest recalculation, including disbursal, repayment, accrual, and reversal scenarios.

methods.name: testInterestBearingProgressiveInterestRecalculationReopenDueReverseRepayment
methods.description: Test method for loans with interest recalculation enabled, verifying accruals, repayments, and reversals.

methods.name: testInterestBearingProgressiveNoInterestRecalculationReopenDueReverseRepayment1b
methods.description: Similar to the first test but scheduled a day later, verifying reverse accruals and overpayment scenarios.

methods.name: testAccrualActivityPostingAndReversalsInterestBearingProgressiveInterestRecalculationMerchantIssuedRefund
methods.description: Testing accrual posting and reversal in presence of merchant issued refunds.

methods.name: testInterestBearingProgressiveNoInterestRecalculationReopenDueReverseRepayment2b
methods.description: Testing reverse accrual postings at a different date with overpayment.

methods.name: testInterestBearingProgressiveNoInterestRecalculationReopenDueReverseRepayment2c
methods.description: Another variation on reverse accrual testing with scheduled date adjustments.

methods.name: testAccrualActivityPosting
methods.description: Test for verifying accrual activity posting at different business days around installment due dates.

methods.name: testAccrualActivityPostingJob
methods.description: Tests the scheduled 'Accrual Activity Posting' job execution and its effect on transactions.

methods.name: testAccrualActivityPostingJobForMultipleLoans
methods.description: Tests batch accrual job post for multiple loans simultaneously at close date.

methods.name: testAccrualActivityPostingReverseReplay
methods.description: Verifies the behavior of reverse and replay of accrual transactions upon repayment reversal.

methods.name: testAccrualActivityPostingForProgressiveLoanWithEarlyRepaymentAndReverseRepayment
methods.description: Examines accrual posting, early repayment, and subsequent reversal in a progressive loan scenario.

methods.name: testAccrualActivityPostingForLoanWithEarlyRepaymentAndReverseRepayment
methods.description: Tests partial repayments and reversals with accrual activity for offsetting penalties and fees.

methods.name: testAccrualActivityPostingForProgressiveMultiDisburseLoanWithEarlyRepayment2ndDisbursement
methods.description: Tests accrual posting across multiple disbursements and early repayments.

methods.name: testAccrualActivityPostingForProgressiveMultiDisburseLoanWithEarlyRepaymentBackdated2ndDisbursement
methods.description: Same as above but with backdated disbursement to test accrual updates.

methods.name: testAccrualActivityPostingForMultiDisburseLoanWithEarlyRepaymentBackdated2ndDisbursement
methods.description: Tests the behavior of accrual posting for multi-disbursement loans with backdated repayments.

methods.name: testAccrualActivityPostingForMultiDisburseProgressiveLoan
methods.description: Tests accrual posting for multi-disbursed progressive loans across multiple periods.

methods.name: testAccrualActivityPostingForMultiDisburseLoan
methods.description: Tests accrual posting for multiple disbursed loans, verifying the correct posting and aggregation.

methods.name: testInterestBearingProgressiveNoInterestRecalculationAutoDownPayment25percentReopenDueReverseRepayment1
methods.description: Verifies interest bearing progressive loans with auto down payment and interest recalculation disabled, testing reversing repayment and status changes.

methods.name: testInterestBearingProgressiveNoInterestRecalculationAutoDownPayment25percentReopenDueReverseRepayment2
methods.description: Tests reversing repayment with interest recalculation disabled, including automatic down payment and overpayment scenario.

methods.name: testInterestBearingProgressiveNoInterestRecalculationAutoDownPayment25percentReopenDueReverseRepayment3
methods.description: Verifies the same scenario as above but adding fees and observing transaction reversals.

methods.name: test
methods.description: A generic test verifying accrual and repayment transactions for a basic loan scenario with daily interest and no interest recalculation.

methods.name: testReverseAndReplayedCoupleOfTimesAfterBackdatedRepayment
methods.description: Tests multiple reversals and replays after a backdated loan repayment, verifying correct transaction states and loan status.
